title: 武术基本功—原地直体后空翻
note: Source is a portrait collage (1080x1920); only the live-video band (rows 579-1336, native 1080x758) is kept, as in scripts/data/backflip_redo.sh. Frames 0-78 = the 79 frames labelled in dataset/backflip_3/annotation.json.
face_mosaic: yolov8n-pose (ultralytics 8.2.42) per frame, plus a 180-degree-rotated pass when the head keypoints are missing (inverted bodies); face box from nose/eyes/ears (1.6x their span, >= 6% of frame height and >= 0.2 x the clip person size), shoulder/box-top fallback, union over +-3 frames, last box reused when nothing is detected; pixelated with block size = box/7. Every person detected (conf >= 0.15) is mosaicked.
license_note: Third-party internet video, faces mosaicked; for research illustration only.
